title: Borrower and Property Qualification Tests for the Larkspur Closing Cost Credit Programs
content:
Beyond the loan itself, each Larkspur Closing Cost Credit program sets its own tests on the borrower and the property: first-time homebuyer status, homebuyer education, income as a percent of area median income, the income level of the property's census tract, how the tract and income tests combine, qualifying occupation, a prior Larkspur loan, and a new home from a Larkspur partner builder.

### First-time homebuyer, education and income

| Credit program | Every borrower must be a first-time homebuyer | Homebuyer education certificate on file before verification | Maximum qualifying income (percent of area median income) | Qualifying census tract income levels | How the tract and income tests combine |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | no | no | no limit | low, moderate, middle, upper | none |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | no | no | no limit | low, moderate, middle, upper | none |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | yes | yes | 120 | low, moderate, middle, upper | income only |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | no | no | no limit | low, moderate, middle, upper | none |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | no | no | no limit | low, moderate, middle, upper | none |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | no | no | 100 | low, moderate | tract or income |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | no | yes | 80 | low, moderate | tract and income |

### Occupation, prior loan and builder tests

| Credit program | Qualifying occupations | Requires a previously consummated Larkspur loan | Prior-loan lookback (calendar months) | Purchase must be a new home from a Larkspur partner builder |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | active military or veteran, law enforcement, firefighter, emergency medical, K-12 educator, nurse | no | 0 | no |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | none (occupation is not a test) | yes | 60 | no |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | none (occupation is not a test) | no | 0 | no |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | none (occupation is not a test) | no | 0 | no |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | none (occupation is not a test) | no | 0 | yes |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | none (occupation is not a test) | no | 0 | no |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | none (occupation is not a test) | no | 0 | no |

### Terms used in the tables

- **Maximum qualifying income** is a whole-number percent of area median income, or no limit.
- **How the tract and income tests combine** takes one of four values: none, income only, tract or income, tract and income.
- **Prior-loan lookback** is counted in calendar months back from the reservation date, within which the prior Larkspur loan must have closed; 0 where a prior loan is not a test.
- A lookback of 0 and "no" in the prior-loan column go together: of the seven programs only the Larkspur Returning Customer Credit sets a prior-loan test.
